gen-gf-chelsea-market-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with lines that sit close to the capitals and little gap between them. Chelsea Market takes the heading with a bold, expressive swing, a loud opener that this classic serif follows without trying to compete.
gen-gf-cherry-bomb-one-fs-rowan: Cherry Bomb One pinches its terminals tight and keeps a single weight throughout, which makes for a loud, commanding heading. Rowan opens every curve and lets thin strokes run about half as heavy as thick ones, so it goes down gently in a text serif.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-fs-rowan: Wide-spaced, sparse, and cheerfully bold up top. Rowan follows with a gentle modulation and open curves, a classic serif that keeps paragraphs friendly beneath such a showy heading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-epunda-slab: Horseshoe curves and heavy diagonals give Cherry Swash a commanding, distinctive face. And Epunda Slab, a text serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, feels dignified and classic next to it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-fauna-one: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe. Fauna One, a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, would read as a literary, dignified stretch of text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, a text serif with big counters, a tall lowercase and curves that stay unclosed. And Cherry Swash, with no pinched joints or flared ends, would look cramped if shrunk down to body size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-hanuman: Cherry Swash holds a single line weight and a horseshoe-shaped c, which gives the heading its commanding, distinctive look. Hanuman, a classic serif, answers quietly with a high-waisted lowercase.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a classic, editorial serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, set under Cherry Swash. Give the heading plenty of size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text gives each curved letter a big visible entrance and lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height. Cherry Swash is the one for commanding headings with no hairlines to squint at, while Noticia Text carries the dignified reading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches the capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp. And Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, would lead a long page with real presence.
